series.name: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger
series.notes: 12 V/24 V small hybrid inverter/charger. Warning = Fault LED flashing + buzzer beeping; fault = Fault LED solid. Several rows in the source table have NO extractable code number (the number column is vector-outlined in the CDR-derived PDF) and are therefore NOT transcribed here - see NEGATIVE. Sibling manual 358-010428-00 prints a similar table but its number column is ambiguous, so it was used only as a weak cross-check, not to assign codes.

meaning.en: The PV module temperature is too high; check airflow and ambient temperature.
meaning.ur: PV module ka temperature bohat zyada hai; airflow aur ambient temperature check karein.

causes.en: Unit installed in a closed room with no airflow
causes.ur: Unit band kamre mein lagi hai jahan airflow nahi hai

causes.en: Direct sun on the unit or the PV input
causes.ur: Unit ya PV input par seedhi dhoop lag rahi hai

causes.en: Internal fan failed so hot air is not expelled
causes.ur: Internal fan kharab hai jis se garm hawa nahi nikalti

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clear dust from the vents and heat sink.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke vents aur heat sink ki dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the unit; keep at least 20 cm clearance on all sides.
solutions.ur: Unit par ambient temperature measure karein; charon taraf kam az kam 20 cm clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Check the internal fan spins freely and its connector is seated on the board.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke internal fan azaad ghoomta hai aur uska connector board par baitha hai.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: PV panel voltage is above the limit (the manual says it should be less than 95 V).
meaning.ur: PV panel ka voltage limit se upar hai (manual ke mutabiq yeh 95 V se kam hona chahiye).

causes.en: Too many small panels in series for a 12 V/24 V unit
causes.ur: 12 V/24 V unit ke liye series mein chhote panels zyada lage hue hain

causes.en: Panel type setting in the setup not matching the fitted panels
causes.ur: Setup mein panel type setting fitted panels se match nahi karti

causes.en: Cold, clear morning with a high open-circuit voltage
causes.ur: Thande aur saaf subah mein open-circuit voltage zyada ho jata hai

solutions.en: Measure the panel open-circuit voltage with a meter; it must stay under 95 V for this unit.
solutions.ur: Panel ka open-circuit voltage meter se measure karein; is unit ke liye woh 95 V se kam rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of panels in series, or set the correct panel type in the setup.
solutions.ur: Series mein panels ki kami karein, ya setup mein sahi panel type set karein.

solutions.en: If the measured voltage is already under 95 V, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Agar measured voltage pehle se 95 V se kam hai to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

aliases: The PV relay voltage is abnormal

title.ur: Warning 06 PV relay ka voltage abnormal hai

meaning.en: The measured voltage across the PV relay is abnormal; an internal component has failed.
meaning.ur: PV relay ke across measured voltage abnormal hai; internal component fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: PV relay contacts burnt or not closing fully
causes.ur: PV relay ke contacts jale ya poori tarah band nahi ho rahe

causes.en: Relay coil driver failed on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par relay coil driver kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Relay wiring or connector loose
causes.ur: Relay wiring ya connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Test the PV relay contacts for continuity; an open reading means replace the relay.
solutions.ur: PV relay contacts ki continuity test karein; open reading aaye to relay replace karein.

solutions.en: Reseat the relay connector and re-tighten the relay wiring before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Relay connector dobara lagayein aur relay wiring dobara tighten karein, phir parts replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Fan 1 is locked; check the fan wiring and replace the fan if needed.
meaning.ur: Fan 1 lock ho gaya hai; fan wiring check karein aur zaroorat ho to fan replace karein.

causes.en: Fan 1 blade jammed by dust or an insect nest
causes.ur: Fan 1 ki blade dhool ya keede ke ghar mein phans gayi

causes.en: Fan 1 bearing seized
causes.ur: Fan 1 ka bearing jam ho gaya

causes.en: Fan 1 connector loose on the board
causes.ur: Board par fan 1 ka connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then check that the fan wiring is connected well.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke check karein ke fan wiring theek lagi hai.

solutions.en: Free the blade by hand and remove any dust or nest; do not force a seized fan.
solutions.ur: Blade ko haath se azaad karein aur dhool ya ghar nikaalein; jamay fan par zor na dein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan with an identical 12 V DC fan of the same size.
solutions.ur: Fan ko wahi 12 V DC fan, same size, se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Fan 2 is locked; check the fan wiring and replace the fan if needed.
meaning.ur: Fan 2 lock ho gaya hai; fan wiring check karein aur zaroorat ho to fan replace karein.

causes.en: Fan 2 blade jammed by dust
causes.ur: Fan 2 ki blade dhool se phans gayi

causes.en: Fan 2 motor failed open circuit
causes.ur: Fan 2 ka motor open circuit ho gaya

causes.en: Fan 2 harness pinched during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran fan 2 ka harness nichal gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the fan 2 connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke fan 2 ka connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Test fan 2 for continuity and free spinning on the bench.
solutions.ur: Bench par fan 2 ki continuity aur azaad ghoomne ka test karein.

solutions.en: Replace fan 2 with the same size and voltage if it is seized or open circuit.
solutions.ur: Fan 2 jam ho ya open circuit ho to same size aur voltage se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: The unit is overloaded; reduce the loads. The Fault LED flashes and the buzzer beeps twice per second.
meaning.ur: Unit overloaded hai; loads kam karein. Fault LED flash karega aur buzzer har second do baar beep karega.

causes.en: Connected appliances exceed the unit's rated VA/W
causes.ur: Lagaye gaye appliances unit ki rated VA/W se zyada hain

causes.en: Motor starting surge on a 1-3 kW unit
causes.ur: 1-3 kW unit par motor ka starting surge

solutions.en: Switch off appliances one at a time until the overload clears.
solutions.ur: Appliances ko aik aik band karein jab tak overload na hat jaye.

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and compare it with the unit's rating label.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage padhein aur usay unit ke rating label se compare karein.

solutions.en: Stagger large motor starts or move them to a separate supply.
solutions.ur: Bare motor starts stagger karein ya alag supply par move karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Battery voltage is too low and it should be charging. Buzzer beeps three times per second.
meaning.ur: Battery ka voltage bohat kam hai aur use charge hona chahiye. Buzzer har second teen baar beep karta hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged during a long outage
causes.ur: Lambi outage mein battery gehri tarah discharge ho gayi

causes.en: PV not generating and grid unavailable
causes.ur: PV se power nahi aa raha aur grid bhi mojood nahi

causes.en: Battery not connected, or wrong battery type configured
causes.ur: Battery lagi hi nahi, ya ghalat battery type configure hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter at the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals par meter se battery voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the PV DC isolator is closed and panels are clean and unshaded.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke PV DC isolator band hai aur panels saaf hain aur unpar shadow nahi hai.

solutions.en: Verify the battery type setting in the LCD setup matches the fitted battery.
solutions.ur: LCD setup mein battery type setting fitted battery se match karti hai ya nahi verify karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Communication between the primary and secondary CPUs is faulty; an internal component has failed.
meaning.ur: Primary aur secondary CPU ke darmiyan communication kharab hai; internal component fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Communication track or connector between the two boards damaged
causes.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan communication track ya connector kharab

causes.en: Supply rail to the secondary processor unstable
causes.ur: Secondary processor ki supply rail unstable hai

causes.en: Firmware versions on the two processors mismatched
causes.ur: Dono processors ke firmware versions mismatch hain

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the inter-board communication connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke boards ke darmiyan communication connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Update the inverter firmware so both processor versions match.
solutions.ur: Inverter firmware update karein taake dono processor versions match ho jayein.

solutions.en: If the fault stays, have the secondary processor board replaced at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Fault bacha to secondary processor board service centre par replace karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

aliases: The inverter current sensor is faulty

meaning.en: The inverter current sensor is faulty; the manual says return it to the repair centre.
meaning.ur: Inverter current sensor kharab hai; manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre wapas bhejein.

causes.en: Current sensing element failed
causes.ur: Current sensing element kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sense wiring disconnected or chafed
causes.ur: Sense wiring nikal gayi ya ragad gayi

causes.en: Sense amplifier on the board failed
causes.ur: Board par sense amplifier kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reported inverter current with a clamp meter; a fixed or zero reading confirms sensor failure.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se reported inverter current compare karein; jam hui ya zero reading sensor failure confirm karti hai.

solutions.en: Have the sensor and its amplifier replaced and the channel calibrated at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par sensor aur uska amplifier replace karke channel calibrate karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: The bus voltage is too low; an internal component has failed or the battery is too weak.
meaning.ur: Bus voltage bohat kam hai; internal component fail hua hai ya battery bohat kamzor hai.

causes.en: Battery too weak to charge the bus at startup
causes.ur: Battery itni kamzor hai ke startup par bus charge nahi kar pata

causes.en: Internal component failure in the bus charge path
causes.ur: Bus charge path mein internal component ki failure

causes.en: Battery connected with reversed polarity
causes.ur: Battery ulat polarity par lagi hui hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter and confirm polarity at the same time.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery voltage measure karein aur usi waqt polarity bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and inspect the bus pre-charge circuit and connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke bus pre-charge circuit aur connectors dekhein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery on a bench if it is below the minimum, then re-test the unit.
solutions.ur: Battery minimum se neeche ho to bench par charge karke unit dobara test karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: AC surge or an internal component failure; bus voltage is too high.
meaning.ur: AC surge ya internal component failure; bus voltage bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: AC surge from the grid or from a switched load
causes.ur: Grid se ya switch hone wale load se AC surge

causes.en: Internal component failure in the bus discharge path
causes.ur: Bus discharge path mein internal component ki failure

causes.en: PV input voltage above the configured limit
causes.ur: PV input voltage configured limit se upar hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then measure PV input voltage at the DC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke DC terminals par PV input voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Restart once as the manual directs; if code 31 returns, do not keep restarting.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq aik baar restart karein; code 31 wapas aaye to baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: Have the bus circuit and the AC surge path inspected at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par bus circuit aur AC surge path ka muaina karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Internal component failure; the bus soft start did not complete.
meaning.ur: Internal component fail hua hai; bus ka soft start mukammal nahi hua.

causes.en: Bus pre-charge circuit open so the capacitors never charge
causes.ur: Bus pre-charge circuit khula hai, is liye capacitors charge nahi hote

causes.en: Internal component failure in the boost stage
causes.ur: Boost stage mein internal component ki failure

causes.en: Output load connected at switch-on
causes.ur: Switch on par output load lagi hui thi

solutions.en: Disconnect all output loads and restart once.
solutions.ur: Saare output loads disconnect karke aik baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and have the pre-charge resistor and boost stage tested.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke pre-charge resistor aur boost stage test karwayein.

solutions.en: Do not power-cycle repeatedly; it can damage the second bridge device.
solutions.ur: Baar baar power-cycle na karein; is se doosra bridge device kharab ho sakta hai.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Over-temperature in radiator 1; check airflow and ambient temperature.
meaning.ur: Radiator 1 mein temperature zyada hai; airflow aur ambient temperature check karein.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se block hai

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the unit's rating
causes.ur: Ambient temperature unit ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Fan 1 or Fan 2 locked
causes.ur: Fan 1 ya Fan 2 lock ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the heat sink with a soft dry brush.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke heat sink ko soft dry brush se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the air flow of the unit is blocked or ambient temperature is too high, as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq check karein ke unit ka air flow block hai ya ambient temperature zyada hai.

solutions.en: Verify both fans spin freely and replace a seized one with the same size and voltage.
solutions.ur: Dono fans azaad ghoomte hain ya nahi check karein aur jamay fan ko same size aur voltage se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: Over-temperature in radiator 2; check airflow and ambient temperature.
meaning.ur: Radiator 2 mein temperature zyada hai; airflow aur ambient temperature check karein.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se block hai

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the unit's rating
causes.ur: Ambient temperature unit ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Fan 2 locked
causes.ur: Fan 2 lock ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the heat sink and radiator 2 fins.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke heat sink aur radiator 2 ki fins saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the air flow of the unit is blocked or ambient temperature is too high.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke unit ka air flow block hai ya ambient temperature zyada hai.

solutions.en: Replace a seized Fan 2 with the same size and voltage fan.
solutions.ur: Jamay hue Fan 2 ko same size aur voltage ke fan se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

meaning.en: EEPROM error; the manual says return the unit to the repair centre.
meaning.ur: EEPROM error hai; manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre wapas bhejein.

causes.en: Power cut while settings were being written
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power cut ho gaya

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed after surge or heat damage
causes.ur: Surge ya garmi ke baad EEPROM chip kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Back up the settings from the app or LCD before any further work.
solutions.ur: Aagey ke kaam se pehle app ya LCD se settings ka backup bana lein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then power-cycle once and check if code 50 clears.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke aik baar power-cycle karein aur dekhein ke code 50 hatta ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it stays, have the EEPROM or control board replaced at the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Fault bache to EEPROM ya control board repair centre par replace karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

title.ur: Fault 90 DSP bootloader likha nahi gaya

meaning.en: The DSP bootloader is missing; the manual says return the unit to the repair centre.
meaning.ur: DSP bootloader mojood nahi; manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre wapas bhejein.

causes.en: Incomplete firmware write during a failed update
causes.ur: Failed update ke dauran firmware adhoora likha gaya

causes.en: Power lost exactly during the bootloader flash
causes.ur: Bootloader flash ke waqt hi power chala gaya

causes.en: DSP or flash memory device failed
causes.ur: DSP ya flash memory device kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Do not attempt to reflash a unit showing code 90; the manual directs return to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Code 90 dikhane wale unit ko dobara flash na karein; manual repair centre wapas bhejne ko kehta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and record the fault code, firmware version and serial number for the service centre.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke fault code, firmware version aur serial number likh lein service centre ke liye.

solutions.en: Have the bootloader re-imaged at the service centre and the unit fully load-tested afterwards.
solutions.ur: Service centre par bootloader dobara likhwayein aur uske baad unit ka poora load test karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)
